verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe documents a synchronous POST /aiservices/scribe/transcribe endpoint that accepts a single local audio or video file up to 100 MB and two hours. It publishes accepted formats (WAV, M4A, MP3, MP4, WebM), and a probed OpenAPI spec confirms the endpoint is real and documented. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of uploads and limit enforcement.
